title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: A store owner bought \(1500\) pencils at \(\$0.10\) each. If he sells them for \(\$0.25\) each, how many of them must he sell to make a profit of exactly \(\$100.00?\)

solutions.text:
The pencils cost \(1500 \times \$0.10 = \$150.\) To make a \(\$100\) profit, the revenue must be \(\$150 + \$100 = \$250.\)

At \(\$0.25\) each, he must sell \(\dfrac{\$250}{\$0.25} = 1000\) pencils.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: First find the total cost of the \(1500\) pencils
The revenue must be the cost plus \(\$100;\) divide that needed revenue by the \(\$0.25\) price
